items.headline: High Court Justice L Nageswara Rao Named Mediator in High-Profile Business Dispute Settlement.
items.teaser: The Supreme Court of India has appointed retired Justice L Nageswara Rao to mediate a long-standing dispute between industrialist Babasah…
items.story:
The Supreme Court of India has appointed retired Justice L Nageswara Rao to mediate a long-standing dispute between industrialist Babasaheb Kalyani and his family members. This development comes after a decade-long feud within the Kalyani family, which owns the Bharat Forge group, a leading manufacturer of automotive and industrial components. The dispute is reportedly valued at over ₹1 lakh crore, making it one of the most high-stakes family feuds in India's corporate history. The Supreme Court's decision to appoint a mediator is seen as a significant attempt to resolve the dispute amicably.

The Kalyani family feud has its roots in a disagreement over the control and management of the Bharat Forge group, which was founded by Babasaheb Kalyani's father. Over the years, the dispute has escalated into a full-blown legal battle, with various family members filing lawsuits against each other. The feud has not only affected the family's personal relationships but also impacted the business operations of the Bharat Forge group, which has significant interests in the automotive, aerospace, and energy sectors. The Supreme Court's intervention is aimed at finding a mutually acceptable solution to the dispute, which has been pending for several years.

According to reports, Justice L Nageswara Rao has been tasked with facilitating a settlement between the warring family members, with the aim of finding a final and binding resolution to the dispute. The Supreme Court has ordered the family members to cooperate with the mediator and explore all possibilities of a settlement. The mediation process is expected to be confidential, with the mediator having the power to call for documents, records, and other information necessary to facilitate a settlement. The Kalyani family has been given a specific timeframe to reach a settlement, although the exact deadline has not been disclosed.

The appointment of a mediator has been welcomed by the Kalyani family members, who have expressed their willingness to cooperate with the process. The move is seen as a positive development, as it offers a chance for the family to resolve their differences amicably and avoid further litigation. The Bharat Forge group's business operations are also expected to benefit from a resolution, as the dispute has been a major distraction for the company's management. The mediation process is being closely watched by India's business community, as it has significant implications for the country's corporate sector.

The Kalyani family feud is not an isolated incident, as several other Indian business families have been embroiled in similar disputes in recent years. The feud highlights the challenges faced by family-owned businesses in India, where succession planning and governance issues can often lead to conflicts. The Supreme Court's decision to appoint a mediator in the Kalyani family dispute sets an important precedent, as it demonstrates the judiciary's willingness to intervene in high-stakes family feuds and facilitate a resolution.

The outcome of the mediation process will be closely watched, as it will have significant implications for the Kalyani family and the Bharat Forge group. If the mediation is successful, it could pave the way for a new era of cooperation and growth for the company, while a failure could lead to further litigation and uncertainty. The Supreme Court's decision to appoint a mediator has raised hopes of a peaceful resolution, and the business community will be watching the developments closely to see if the Kalyani family can put their differences behind them and move forward.

items.story:
In Maharashtra, a shocking scam has been exposed, revealing that approximately 2.3 crore litres of synthetic milk were manufactured using detergent powder, sparking widespread concern over food safety in the region. The discovery was made as part of a statewide crackdown on food safety violations, led by the Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA). This operation has been one of the toughest in recent years, with the FDA commissioner, Tukaram Mundhe, at the helm. The scam has raised questions about the effectiveness of existing regulations and the need for stricter enforcement.

The issue of synthetic milk and adulterated dairy products is not new to Maharashtra, with previous instances of contamination and safety breaches reported in the past. However, the scale of the current scam has caught authorities off guard, highlighting the need for more robust monitoring and testing mechanisms. The FDA has been working to strengthen its oversight, particularly in the dairy sector, where analog paneer samples have been found to be unsafe in significant numbers. The drive to improve food safety has been gaining momentum, with the state government taking steps to ban the sale of loose milk and increase inspections.

According to official reports, the synthetic milk was produced using a combination of detergent powder, water, and other chemicals, posing serious health risks to consumers. The FDA has been conducting raids and seizures, resulting in the recovery of large quantities of adulterated milk and dairy products. Commissioner Mundhe has stated that around 40% of analog paneer samples tested were found to be unsafe, underscoring the gravity of the situation. The FDA has also been working to raise awareness among consumers about the dangers of adulterated food products and the importance of purchasing from reputable sources.

The exposure of the synthetic milk scam has sent shockwaves through the dairy industry, with stakeholders calling for stricter regulations and more effective enforcement. Consumers have expressed outrage and concern over the safety of the milk and dairy products they purchase, with many demanding more transparency and accountability from manufacturers and authorities. The issue has also sparked a wider debate about food safety and the need for more robust testing and monitoring mechanisms to prevent such scams in the future. The state government has assured the public that it is taking all necessary steps to address the issue and prevent similar incidents.

The scam has also highlighted the importance of food safety in the broader context of public health, with experts warning that consuming adulterated products can have serious health consequences. The issue is not unique to Maharashtra, with reports of food safety breaches emerging from other parts of the country as well. The need for a more coordinated and effective approach to food safety has been emphasized, with calls for greater investment in testing and monitoring infrastructure. The FDA's crackdown in Maharashtra is seen as a step in the right direction, but more needs to be done to address the issue comprehensively.

As the investigation into the synthetic milk scam continues, authorities are expected to take further action against those responsible, including manufacturers and distributors. The FDA is likely to intensify its inspections and testing, with a focus on preventing similar scams in the future. The state government has also announced plans to review and strengthen existing regulations, with a view to improving food safety outcomes. With the public demanding greater accountability and transparency, the authorities will be under pressure to deliver results and ensure that the food supply chain is safe and secure for all consumers.

The warrant was issued due to Saeed's involvement in the attack, and his failure to appear before the court. The development marks a significant step in the case, which has been ongoing for some time. Saeed's whereabouts are currently unknown, but it is believed that he is living in Pakistan.

Lashkar-e-Taiba, the militant group founded by Saeed, has been responsible for numerous terrorist attacks in the past, including the 2008 Mumbai attacks. The group has been banned in several countries, including India and the United States, and Saeed has been designated as a global terrorist by the United Nations. The case against Saeed is part of a larger effort to bring those responsible for terrorist attacks to justice.

According to official statements, the non-bailable warrant was issued due to Saeed's failure to appear before the court, despite being summoned several times. The warrant paves the way for a trial in absentia, which could result in Saeed being convicted and sentenced to prison. The National Investigation Agency has been investigating the Pahalgam terror attack, and has gathered significant evidence against Saeed and other accused individuals. The agency has stated that it will continue to pursue the case vigorously and bring those responsible to justice.

The issuance of the non-bailable warrant against Hafiz Saeed has been welcomed by many, who see it as a significant step towards bringing the perpetrator of the Pahalgam terror attack to justice. The development has also been seen as a major blow to Lashkar-e-Taiba and its operatives, who have been responsible for numerous terrorist attacks in the region. However, some have expressed concerns about the ability of the authorities to bring Saeed to justice, given his current whereabouts and the challenges of extradition. The reaction to the development has been mixed, with some hailing it as a major success and others expressing skepticism.

The development has significant regional and global implications, particularly in the context of the fight against terrorism. The issuance of the non-bailable warrant against Hafiz Saeed sends a strong message that those responsible for terrorist attacks will be held accountable, regardless of their location or influence. The case also highlights the need for international cooperation in the fight against terrorism, particularly in cases where perpetrators are living in other countries. The development is likely to be closely watched by countries around the world, particularly those that have been affected by Lashkar-e-Taiba's terrorist activities.

The next steps in the case against Hafiz Saeed are unclear, but it is likely that the National Investigation Agency will continue to pursue the case vigorously. The development is also likely to be closely watched by human rights groups and other organizations, who will be monitoring the case to ensure that Saeed's rights are respected and that he is given a fair trial. items.story:
Iraq's economic stability has been temporarily secured after Turkey agreed to a one-year arrangement ensuring the continued flow of critical oil exports from northern Iraq to the Turkish port of Ceyhan. The agreement, reached on 27 July, will allow Iraq to maintain its vital oil exports, which are a key source of revenue for the country. This development comes as a significant relief for Iraq, which was facing the possibility of economic disaster if the oil exports had been disrupted. The new arrangement will cover the entire Iraq-Turkey Pipeline corridor, treating it as a single, unified mechanism.

The Iraq-Turkey Pipeline has been in operation since the 1970s, with the original Crude Oil Pipeline Agreement signed in 1973. Over the years, the pipeline has played a crucial role in Iraq's economy, with oil exports accounting for a significant portion of the country's revenue. However, the pipeline's operation has been disrupted several times due to various factors, including conflicts and diplomatic tensions between Iraq and Turkey. The latest agreement is seen as a positive development, as it will allow Iraq to maintain its oil exports and avoid a potential economic crisis.

According to officials, the new one-year protocol will cover the entire Iraq-Turkey Pipeline corridor, including two separate oil pipelines. The agreement is expected to provide a stable and secure environment for oil exports, which will help to boost Iraq's economy. Iraqi officials have welcomed the agreement, stating that it will help to maintain the country's oil exports and ensure a stable revenue stream. The exact terms of the agreement have not been disclosed, but it is understood that it will be reviewed and renewed after one year.

The agreement has been met with relief from stakeholders, including oil companies and investors, who had been concerned about the potential disruption to oil exports. The news has also been welcomed by international organizations, which had been monitoring the situation closely. The continued flow of oil exports from Iraq is expected to have a positive impact on the global oil market, helping to maintain stability and prevent price fluctuations. However, some analysts have cautioned that the agreement is only a temporary solution and that a more permanent arrangement will be needed to ensure long-term stability.

The agreement is also seen as a significant development in the context of regional politics, as it reflects a willingness by Turkey and Iraq to cooperate on key economic issues. The two countries have had a complex relationship in recent years, with disagreements over issues such as border security and trade. However, the agreement on the Iraq-Turkey Pipeline suggests that they are able to put aside their differences and work together on matters of mutual interest. The development is also expected to have implications for the broader region, as it will help to maintain stability and security in the Middle East.

As the one-year agreement comes into effect, attention will turn to the long-term future of the Iraq-Turkey Pipeline and the broader implications for Iraq's economy. Iraqi officials will need to work with their Turkish counterparts to negotiate a more permanent arrangement, which will require careful consideration of issues such as pipeline maintenance, security, and revenue sharing. The international community will also be watching closely, as the stability of Iraq's oil exports has significant implications for global energy markets and regional security. The Indian sailor was among those killed in the strike, which was carried out by the US in response to Iranian actions. The development has raised concerns about the safety of Indian nationals in the region and the potential impact on India's relations with Iran.

The killing of the Indian sailor is the latest development in a series of escalating tensions between the US and Iran, which have been ongoing for several weeks. The tensions began when the US withdrew from a nuclear deal with Iran and imposed sanctions on the country, leading to a significant escalation in rhetoric and actions from both sides. The US has carried out several strikes on Iranian targets in recent days, including a strike on a Iranian military base, in response to what it says are Iranian provocations. The situation has raised concerns about the potential for further escalation and the impact on regional stability.

According to official statements, the Indian sailor was killed in a strike on an Iranian oil tanker, which was carrying a cargo of crude oil. The strike was carried out by the US in response to what it says was an Iranian attack on a US drone. The Indian government has sought clarification from Iran on the circumstances surrounding the incident and has asked for measures to be taken to ensure the safety of Indian nationals in the region. The US has said that it is committed to de-escalating tensions with Iran, but has also warned that it will take further action if necessary to protect its interests.

The killing of the Indian sailor has sparked widespread concern and outrage in India, with many calling for the government to take action to ensure the safety of Indian nationals in the region. The Indian government has said that it is working to ensure the safe return of Indian nationals from the region and has asked for international cooperation to de-escalate tensions. The incident has also raised concerns about the potential impact on India's relations with Iran, which is a major supplier of oil to India. The Indian government has said that it will continue to engage with Iran to resolve the situation and ensure the safety of Indian nationals.

The escalation of tensions between the US and Iran has significant regional and global implications, with many countries calling for calm and restraint. The US has said that it is committed to working with its allies to de-escalate tensions, but has also warned that it will take further action if necessary to protect its interests. The situation has raised concerns about the potential for further escalation and the impact on global oil prices, which have already risen significantly in recent days. The international community is watching the situation closely, with many calling for a peaceful resolution to the crisis.

As the situation continues to unfold, the Indian government is expected to continue to engage with Iran and the US to resolve the situation and ensure the safety of Indian nationals. The US has said that it is open to talks with Iran, but has also warned that it will not tolerate any further provocations. The international community is waiting to see how the situation will develop, with many hoping for a peaceful resolution to the crisis. items.story: വനിതാ കണ്ടക്ടറുടെ വിശദീകരണം : ‘സർവീസ് തീരും മുൻപേ ഇറങ്ങിയത് ഭർത്താവിന് അസുഖം കൂടിയതിനാൽ’ Manorama Online‘പോയത് ഭർത്താവിന് അസുഖം കൂടിയതിനാൽ’; ഡ്യൂട്ടിക്കിടെ മൂന്നാർ ബസിൽ നിന്ന് ഇറങ്ങിപ്പോയ വനിതാ കണ്ടക്ടർ Manorama Onlineവനിതാ കണ്ടക്ടർ സർവീസ് തീരും മുമ്പ് ചെകുത്താൻ മുക്കിൽ വച്ച് ജോലി അവസാനിപ്പിച്ചു; കെഎസ്ആർടിസി അന്വേഷിക്കും News18 Malayalamഡ്യൂട്ടി അവസാനിക്കാൻ അരമണിക്കൂർ ബാക്കി: പാതിവഴിയിൽ ഇറങ്ങി വീട്ടിൽപോയി വനിതാ കണ്ടക്ടർ Kerala Kaumudiഓട്ടം തീരും മുമ്പേ വനിതാ കണ്ടക്ടര്‍ വഴിയിലിറങ്ങി വീട്ടില്‍ പോയ

items.story: വിജയ് സർക്കാരിന് ആശ്വാസം, സംസ്ഥാന വ്യാപകമായി ഗോവധ നിരോധനത്തിനുള്ള മദ്രാസ് ഹൈക്കോടതി ഉത്തരവിന് സുപ്രീം കോടതി സ്റ്റേ Asianet News Malayalamവിജയിച്ച് വിജയ് സർക്കാർ: ഗോവധ നിരോധനത്തിൽ മദ്രാസ് ഹൈക്കോടതി ഉത്തരവിന് സുപ്രീം കോടതിയുടെ സ്റ്റേ Manorama Onlineവിജയ്‌‌ക്ക് അനുകൂല വിധിയുമായി സുപ്രീംകോടതി: ഗോവധ നിരോധന ഉത്തരവിന് സ്റ്റേ Kerala Kaumudiതമിഴ്‌നാട്ടിലെ ഗോവധ നിരോധന ഉത്തരവിന് സ്‌റ്റേ; വിജയ് സര്‍ക്കാരിന് അനുകൂല വിധിയുമായി സുപ്രിംകോടതി Suprabhaatham Onlineഗോവധ നിരോധനത്തിൽ മദ്രാസ് ഹൈക്കോടതി ഉത്തരവ് സ്റ്റേ

items.story: ഡോ. റാം എവിടെ? ആന്ധ്രയിൽ പൊലീസിനെ വിരട്ടി; സഹായം സഹോദരൻ തെലുഗുദേശം നേതാവ് ! Manorama Online'മനുഷ്യത്വരഹിതം, അധ്യാപകൻ ഇങ്ങനെ ആണോ പ്രവർത്തിക്കേണ്ടത്'; ഡോ. റാമിന് തിരിച്ചടി, മുൻകൂർ ജാമ്യാപേക്ഷ തള്ളി സുപ്രീംകോടതി Asianet News Malayalamകാലംമാറി, മോശമായി പെരുമാറുന്ന അധ്യാപകർ തിരിച്ചറിയണം; റാമിന്റെ മുൻ‌കൂർ ജാമ്യാപേക്ഷ തള്ളി സുപ്രീംകോടതി Mathrubhumi'മനുഷ്യത്വരഹിതം': നിതിൻ രാജിന്റെ മരണത്തിൽ ഡോ.റാമിന്റെ മുൻകൂർ ജാമ്യാപേക്ഷ തള്ളി സുപ്രീംകോടതി Kerala Kaumudiനിതിന്‍രാജിന്റെ മരണം: ഡോ റാമിന് തിരിച്ചടി, മുന്‍കൂര
